text: The figures show strong financial performance, with revenue of 1,055,780, a 17% EBITDA margin, PAT of 95,754 and a 10.6% ROE, while Q2FY27 revenue and PAT grew 29.8% and 33.8% year‑on‑year and operating cash flow is 1.9 times PAT. However, the stretched working‑capital cycle from –28 to 24 days raises a cautionary note despite the positive profitability metrics.
